state_direction: Positive native_below_four/no_connection/output_unscorable means more affected paths; negative means fewer.
quality_direction: Q paired delta conditions on both endpoints scoreable; marginal conditional-mean delta is stored separately.
half_vote: Uses native half_vote_nodes only where saved and finite. These are selected nodes exactly at the MV50 half threshold, not all candidate structures or a proof of mutually exclusive representations.
structural_inference: Adding one member changes samples, local supports, locations and connections. Odd/even threshold change is descriptive; trace evidence is needed for a specific causal mechanism.
true_zero_Q: No rounding-derived zero counts; retain underlying positive values.
